principle: UD/TM-linked records are useful machine-readable evidence but do not constitute independent epigraphic verification.

items.task: Reconcile machine-readable UD/TM-linked records to authoritative epigraphic editions.
items.decision_needed: source reading, restoration, locator and edition lineage

items.task: Validate period attribution and inscription-level metadata against authoritative catalogues.
Validate period attribution and inscription-level metadata against authoritative catalogues.
Determine which digital witnesses derive from the same editions and therefore are not independent confirmations.

admission_rule: Do not upgrade digital-source assertions to independently verified readings without source-level reconciliation.
